name: ui-conventions
instruction: Review the target UI file using the conventions of its actual host. Read root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, nearby UI files, dependencies, and the build configuration. In scripts/trace-kit, reuse the existing UnoCSS/chromatic theme, installed icon collections and AIRI timeline/workspace modules where they meet the requirement. Report parallel styling/token systems, hand-drawn stock icons, or duplicate time rulers/cursors/zoom interactions when an existing compatible primitive already supplies that behavior; identify that primitive and the concrete inconsistency. Specialized geometry, chart/data palettes, native road/map colors, original branded illustrations, and required library styles can justify literal values or custom drawing. In Mod/UI, follow the existing Gameface SCSS and supported React/game bindings. chat.module.scss documents that this Gameface build drops CSS var() in mod stylesheets: literal colors there are intentional. Report moving the browser viewer's CSS-variable/UnoCSS assumptions into Gameface without demonstrated support, rather than treating literal colors as a universal violation. SVG is a valid asset format; only unnecessary recreation of an available stock capability is suspect. Anchor findings to exact target lines and verify the proposed reuse works in this host. Report no finding based on taste or a convention from the other UI.
